description: **Note**: This is book two of the Experiment series. Read _Experiment T_ before this.
Markus never asked for this life.

At four he was captured, at thirteen he was serving in the military, at seventeen he was in high school, and by nineteen the apocalypse began. Through all of this he never forgot where it all started: the Organization. It has no name—never has—so he liked to refer to it as the Cult after all they've done.

So, when the world collapses, he finds himself thriving. Brutal combat, resource management, danger behind every corner, to him it's just... normal. Things feel easy; he begins to believe that he actually can solve any problem alone. Heck, if everyone else is struggling to get by, why shouldn't he capitalize on his advantage. It's only fair.
His approach works, he's skilled enough to solve every problem that comes his way and the consequences might as well be non-existent.
